items.text: 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance, reachable by call, SMS, panic button or the 112 India app.
In Tamil Nadu, dial 108 for an emergency ambulance.
Potholes, damaged roads and broken footpaths in Madurai city are handled by the Madurai City Municipal Corporation (roads and engineering).
Uncollected garbage, overflowing bins, dumping, dead animals and public toilets are handled by the Corporation's sanitation and solid waste wing.
Drinking water supply, leaking pipes, blocked drains, sewage overflow and waterlogging are handled by the Corporation's water supply and drainage wing.
Street lights that are off or flickering are handled by the Corporation's street lighting wing.
Power cuts, fallen or sparking lines and transformer faults go to the state electricity distribution utility (label to be confirmed locally).
Bus services, bus stops and traffic signals go to the public transport / transport authorities (label to be confirmed locally).
Parks, playgrounds, public ponds and encroachment on public land are handled by the Corporation's parks and public spaces wing.
Crime, harassment and safety threats that need police go to Madurai City Police; in an emergency call 112.
Madurai Corporation routes civic grievances to the area assistant engineer and escalates them if no action is taken within three days.
Neighbours may organise a small clean-up with gloves and bags, but must never handle sharp, medical, chemical or dead-animal waste.
Neighbours may organise a park clean-up or planting day together with the park's caretaker.
Problem 360 only recommends a department. It never contacts a department and never says it has.
Urgent, duplicate and unclear reports are marked for a person to review before anything happens.
A report that closely matches a recent nearby report of the same category is checked as a possible duplicate.
A report that does not say what is wrong or where gets up to three short questions before it is routed.
